name: A month of books of a Kampala trading company, VAT-registered and filing monthly

documents.why: A domestic sale at the standard rate of 18 %: box 4 and the output VAT of box 8.
A residential lease exempt under paragraph 1(f) of the Second Schedule: box 3, no output VAT, and a matched payment later on.
An export of goods, zero-rated under paragraph 1(a) of the Third Schedule: box 2, no output VAT, and a matched payment later on.
A domestic sale of a good the Third Schedule zero-rates without it leaving Uganda, so a zero rate is proven that is neither a domestic reverse charge nor an export: box 1.
A credit note for one unit returned from INV-001, so box 4 and box 8 fall back down and a sale_credit_note is exercised.

lines.name: Office stationery, retail sale — one unit returned

documents.why: A domestic purchase at the standard rate, deductible in full: box 13 and the input VAT of box 20, and a matched payment later on.
A purchase of a zero-rated good from a registered supplier: no input tax, reported in box 11.
An insurance premium, exempt under paragraph 1(d) of the Second Schedule: no input tax, and this pack's form has no box for an exempt purchase.
An import of goods: VAT charged at the border under section 4(b), claimed as input tax through box 15, and held on the customs control account until settled.

A service imported from a supplier with no place of business in Uganda: the recipient self-charges the output tax of box 9(i) under section 4(c) and claims it back through box 21(i), netting to nothing on a wholly taxable purchase.
A purchase credit note for a short delivery on PINV-001, so box 13 and box 20 fall back down and a purchase_credit_note is exercised.

lines.name: Trading stock purchased for resale — short-delivery credit

payments.why: The residential rent of INV-002 collected in full: a matched inbound payment on an exempt sale.
The export of INV-003 collected in full: a matched inbound payment in a foreign trade relationship.
PINV-001 settled in full, VAT included: a matched outbound payment.
An advance received from Eldoret Highlands Coffee Ltd before its next shipment, matched to nothing: reconcile() has to survive an open item.
